column3: “The passover” (the second) is rendered “the Passover animals.”
“Duties” is rendered “offices.”
NASB supplies “who were”; “the ark of holiness” is rendered “the holy ark,” and “not to you a burden” as “it will be a burden … no longer.”
“Prepare” is rendered “prepare yourselves.”
“The sons of the people” is rendered “the lay people”; the Hebrew is terse, and NASB supplies “according to.”
“The passover” is rendered “the Passover animals,” and “by the hand of Moses” as “by Moses.”
“The sons of the people” is rendered “the lay people.”
NASB supplies “from the flocks.”
NASB spells “Conaniah” and supplies “from the flocks.”
“Arranged” is rendered “prepared,” and “took their stand” as “stood.”
NASB supplies “the blood received.”
“Put aside” is rendered “removed,” and “the sons of the people” as “the lay people.” NASB supplies “They did this.”
“Cooked” is rendered “roasted,” and “holy offerings” as “holy things.” “The children of the people” is rendered “the lay people.”
NASB supplies “therefore.”
“To a gate and a gate” is rendered “at each gate”; “not to them to turn aside” is rendered “did not have to depart.”
“Arranged” is rendered “prepared.”
“Found” is rendered “present.”
“Found” is rendered “present.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Prepared the house” is rendered “set the temple in order,” and “to meet him” as “to engage him.”

“What is to me and to you” is rendered “What have we to do with each other.” NASB supplies “I am … coming”; “the house of my battle” is rendered “the house with which I am at war,” and “cease for yourself from God” as “Stop for your own sake from interfering with God.”
“Turn round his face” is rendered “turn away”; “the valley” is rendered “the plain.”
“Wounded exceedingly” is rendered “badly wounded.”
“Made him ride” is rendered “carried him,” and “graves” as “tombs.”
“Made a lament” is rendered “chanted a lament,” and “have said” as “speak about.” “Decree” is rendered “ordinance”; NASB adds “also.”
“Covenant loyalties” is rendered “deeds of devotion.”
“Matters” is rendered “acts.”
